observations.behavior: Adds OAuth authorization-granted and token-issued event capture, replacing registration-type inline checks with a shared helper; also adds token-rejected and scope-rejection event capture.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds an OAuth authorization-granted event to track successful authorization and the granted scopes, including scoped organizations and teams, and the grant path. This could help PostHog distinguish clients that complete authorization but fail downstream from those that never reach the consent screen, and could support funnel and compliance reporting.

observations.behavior: Replaces inline OAuth registration-type properties with a shared helper; removes redundant client-name and app-id properties from the authorization-requested event.
observations.posthog_connection: Centralizes OAuth app event properties, potentially improving consistency and maintainability of OAuth-related analytics. This could help PostHog maintain a consistent set of OAuth-related properties across different OAuth flows.

observations.behavior: Adds OAuth authorization-granted event capture for first-party and auto-approval paths, alongside existing scopes-clamped and token-issued events.

observations.behavior: Adds a new property, $mcp_auth_method, to the analytics context and its emitted properties.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows PostHog users to distinguish authentication mechanisms (OAuth, personal API key, ID-JAG) in MCP traffic, supporting better diagnostics and grouping.

observations.behavior: Adds a new function, trackAuthFailure, that captures failed authentication requests before they reach the tool-call tracking path.
observations.posthog_connection: Records authentication failures with a dedicated event, preserving the token hash and failure reason, while not exposing the bearer token. This helps users identify credential or permission issues without losing the request or identifying the user.

observations.behavior: Adds an authMethod field to the MCPRequestContext interface and its construction, populated by classifyAuthMethod.
observations.posthog_connection: Establishes the typed property and its value, enabling downstream analytics and diagnostics to distinguish authentication methods.
